subject: [PATCH 2/2] mm: zswap: use stack requests for synchronous decompression

reviews.author: Usama Arif
reviews.summary: Identified that the proposed change may not be beneficial for zstd and suggested considering it as a follow-up patch for stateless decompressors like lz4.

2026-10-09.patch_summary: Proposal to use separate compression and decompression requests in zswap, with a potential follow-up patch for stateless decompressors like lz4.

reviews.author: Sergey Senozhatsky
reviews.summary: Confirmed that zstd and deflate decomp contexts are mutable and cannot be shared, implicitly supporting the proposed change.
reviews.raw_body:
On (26/10/09 17:26), Usama Arif wrote:
> Thanks for the inital patches!

Thank you for working on this!

> > Catch me if you can ;P
> > 
> > [1] https://lore.kernel.org/all/20261009071157.3730698-12-senozhatsky@chromium.org
> 
> I think it wont help zstd, right? It would help stateless decompressors like
> lz4 I think.

Correct, zstd and deflate decomp contexts are mutable, cannot be shared.

2026-10-10.patch_summary: Proposal to use separate compression and decompression requests in zswap, with a potential follow-up patch for stateless decompressors like lz4.
